'''Yirpa Garajon''' was a [[human]] who lived on the planet [[Savareen]] in [[Pnakotic Coast village|a village]] on the [[Pnakotic Coast]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> They had the task of concluding landing rights and trade agreements with all who landed at the [[Bis Refinery]]. In return for their services and the refinery, the Savarians asked for medicines, technology, [[Foodstuff|food]] or [[clothing]], as they accepted no [[Galactic Credit Standard|Credits]]. Garajon was sometimes assisted by their fellow villagers [[Vamasto Maja]] or [[Taraja Cuttsmay]].<ref name="TOG" /> They were present in their village when [[Tobias Beckett]]'s [[Beckett's gang|crew]] came to Savareen<ref name="Solo" /> in [[10 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Savareen]] in [[Solo: A Star Wars Story]] to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore the event on Savareen in Solo must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> to refine [[Coaxium]] that they had [[Raid on Kessel|stolen]] from [[Spice mines of Kessel]].<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Yirpa Garajon was a human with tan skin and black [[eye]]s. They were able to communicate in [[sign language]].<ref name="TOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yirpa Garajon first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first named in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TOG" />
